name: @forest/issuer
description: The Forest Foundation's issuer: it signs notes. A passed Didit face check gives a person a tier 1 note for their note number, with their face embedding from an open model (SFace); a passed document check, with the live face matching the note's, the same note at tier 2. It keeps which check session gave which note number, and a keyed fingerprint of each document next to it. With a welcome gift, at a person's first note it signs a sponsor's ticket for the credits their app buys at the registry payer and the host.
